provenance.geometry_and_field: Prescribed theoretical baseline; lab z is the common NV axis.
provenance.gamma_e: Positive coefficient g_e=-gamma_e_phys in H_Z=g_e B.S; magnitude g_e/(2*pi) approximately 28024.95 MHz/T. The physical electron gyromagnetic ratio is negative.
provenance.bare_detuning: Chosen zero reference-minus-transition detuning before dipolar projection shifts.
provenance.units: Positions: m; fields: T; gradients: T/m; D, E and detuning: rad/us; gamma_e: rad/us/T.
provenance.constraints: Chosen trial bounds: minimum separation 5 nm and maximum field magnitude 20 mT at NV sites; not validated fabrication or hardware limits.
provenance.numerics: Chosen baseline: static interval exponentials and comparison tolerances of 1e-10; numerical accuracy must be checked during propagation.

source_protocol_report.target_convention: exp(-i*sign(J_ab)*pi*Z_a*Z_b/4), spectator identity, site zero leftmost; no local corrections.
limits: Sign averages apply to the static longitudinal model.
No finite-pulse, nuclear or leakage dynamics are evaluated.
No gate propagation or fidelity calculation is performed.

schedule.envelope_convention: Unit mean over each pulse window.

target_convention: The target matrix is interpreted separately in each stated frame.
limits: Same polarised-branch calibration for both preparations.
Nuclear memory retained throughout the complete sequence.
No nuclear reset or physical local corrections.
One prescribed magnetic trajectory; not an ensemble average.

magnetic_trajectory.source: Conditional OU fit to Joas NV1 coherence scales; same scale borrowed for all three sites.

reference.reference_site: Joas NV1; not calibrated for the ECHO register
assumptions: Coherence times interpreted as environmental 1/e envelope times.
Deterministic nitrogen beating excluded from the fitted envelope.
Negligible relaxation and pulse errors in the reference fit.
Nominal central values only; uncertainties not propagated.
Transfer to the three-NV register is a scenario choice.

limits: One trajectory per site, not an ensemble estimate.
Independent axial fields are a chosen spatial model.
Not calibrated for the ECHO register.
